item.title: Indiana Fever Surge: The Surprising 2026 Rise
item.description:
Would you believe a team missing its biggest star for two straight games could still be one of the hottest stories in basketball? That’s exactly the paradox the Indiana Fever are living right now.

The Fever entered Wednesday night with a 12-8 record, two All-Star starters, and a two-game winning streak they were trying to push to three. For a franchise that spent years rebuilding, this is a genuine turning point.

item.title: Sophie Cunningham's Surprising Return: Faith, Fever, and a $665K Bet
item.description:
How does a player coming off a torn MCL turn a one-year, $665,000 contract into one of the most-talked-about stories of the 2026 WNBA offseason? Ask Sophie Cunningham — she just did it.

In the span of a single week, the Indiana Fever guard re-signed with her team, got publicly baptized as an adult on TikTok, joined USA Sports as a broadcasting contributor, and reignited the chemistry of the WNBA’s most marketable trio. It is a wild moment for a player whose career arc had quietly stalled less than a year ago.
